# Eating on 30A

> Restaurant guide for Scenic Highway 30A in Walton County, Florida.

Eating on 30A is a restaurant guide for Scenic Highway 30A in South Walton. Find breakfast, lunch, and dinner from Dune Allen to Inlet Beach, with the address, the hours, and a feel for the place.

The towns along the highway are Dune Allen, Gulf Place, Blue Mountain, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove, Seacrest, Watersound, Alys Beach, Rosemary Beach, Inlet Beach, and Watersound Origins. Nearby is US 98 dining a short drive from Scenic Highway 30A.

- [Map](https://www.eatingon30a.com/map/)

## Towns

- [Dune Allen Beach](https://www.eatingon30a.com/areas/dune-allen-beach/): Explore the full stretch of 30A, from laid-back beach towns to vibrant coastal communities, all in one place. Restaurants in Dune Allen Beach on Scenic Highway 30A.
- [Gulf Place](https://www.eatingon30a.com/areas/gulf-place/): A vibrant hub on the west end of 30A with colorful architecture, local shops, live music, and easy beach access. Restaurants in Gulf Place on Scenic Highway 30A.
- [Blue Mountain Beach](https://www.eatingon30a.com/areas/blue-mountain-beach/): A relaxed beach town with local eats and a friendly community. Restaurants in Blue Mountain Beach on Scenic Highway 30A.
- [Grayton Beach](https://www.eatingon30a.com/areas/grayton-beach/): A laid-back, artsy beach town with pristine beaches and local flavor. Restaurants in Grayton Beach on Scenic Highway 30A.
- [WaterColor](https://www.eatingon30a.com/areas/watercolor/): Upscale and family-friendly with beautiful beaches and scenic trails. Restaurants in WaterColor on Scenic Highway 30A.
- [Seaside](https://www.eatingon30a.com/areas/seaside/): The iconic heart of 30A. Charming, walkable, and full of coastal character. Restaurants in Seaside on Scenic Highway 30A.
- [Seagrove Beach](https://www.eatingon30a.com/areas/seagrove-beach/): A laid-back, tree-lined beach community with a mix of old Florida charm and modern coastal living. Restaurants in Seagrove Beach on Scenic Highway 30A.
- [Seacrest](https://www.eatingon30a.com/areas/seacrest/): A peaceful retreat with sugar-white sands and easy access to fun. Restaurants in Seacrest on Scenic Highway 30A.
- [Watersound](https://www.eatingon30a.com/areas/watersound/): A beach stretch east of Seagrove, with casual dining along County Highway 30A. Restaurants in Watersound on Scenic Highway 30A.
- [Alys Beach](https://www.eatingon30a.com/areas/alys-beach/): Striking architecture, upscale shopping, and a peaceful beachfront vibe. Restaurants in Alys Beach on Scenic Highway 30A.
- [Rosemary Beach](https://www.eatingon30a.com/areas/rosemary-beach/): European-inspired charm with cobblestone streets and a vibrant atmosphere. Restaurants in Rosemary Beach on Scenic Highway 30A.
- [Inlet Beach](https://www.eatingon30a.com/areas/inlet-beach/): Trendy, up-and-coming, and close to the action. Restaurants in Inlet Beach on Scenic Highway 30A.
- [Watersound Origins](https://www.eatingon30a.com/areas/watersound-origins/): An inland town center north of 30A, with everyday restaurants around the square. Restaurants in Watersound Origins on Scenic Highway 30A.
- [Nearby](https://www.eatingon30a.com/areas/nearby/): Everyday dining on the US 98 plazas, a short drive from Scenic Highway 30A. Restaurants Nearby on US 98, near Scenic Highway 30A.
